rejected_because: UNCONFIRMED SINCE 2013. The discovery paper called it only 'tantalizing'; not recovered by Feroz & Hobson 2014, Robertson & Mahadevan 2014 or Tuomi et al. 2019. Never formally refuted.
reference: Anglada-Escude et al. 2013, A&A 556, A126, Table 4 and Sect. 3

rejected_because: NOT RECOVERED. Diaz et al. 2016 find no defined period and their model comparison rules out the six-signal model. NASA does not list it.
reference: Tuomi et al. 2013, A&A 549, A48, Table 4; not confirmed by Diaz et al. 2016, A&A 585, A134

rejected_because: REFUTED. ESPRESSO should have detected it and does not (Figueira et al. 2025); NASA has removed it.
reference: Feng et al. 2017, AJ 154, 135, 'Color difference makes a difference: four planet candidates around tau Ceti', Table 5; contested by Figueira et al. 2025, A&A 700, A174

rejected_because: DOUBTFUL. The discovery authors say the RV slope is consistent with long-term instrument drift (Morgan et al. 2026). No orbit.
reference: Morgan et al. 2026, AJ, arXiv:2605.11127, abstract

rejected_because: NO EVIDENCE. Lagrange et al. 2025 put the PMa below 2 sigma once instrument noise is included. That is no evidence, not proof of absence.
reference: Gratton et al. 2024, A&A 685, A119, Table 5

reference: Tuomi et al. 2019, arXiv:1906.04644, Table of planet candidates (GJ3822 c)
